episodes.title: What Is Artificial Intelligence?
episodes.description: Introduce artificial intelligence through everyday applications, capabilities, limitations, and its development.

episodes.title: Supervised Learning
episodes.description: Use labeled examples to train a simple artificial neuron to distinguish two kinds of food.

episodes.title: Neural Networks and Deep Learning
episodes.description: Combine artificial neurons into layered networks that recognize more complicated patterns.

episodes.title: Training Neural Networks
episodes.description: Explore backpropagation, weight adjustments, error reduction, and challenges in finding better network solutions.

episodes.title: How to make an AI read your handwriting (LAB)
episodes.description: Build and refine a handwriting-recognition network using labeled character data and existing software tools.

episodes.title: Unsupervised Learning
episodes.description: Use clustering to uncover patterns in data without supplying categories in advance.

episodes.title: Natural Language Processing
episodes.description: Investigate computational approaches to understanding the human language used in searches, assistants, and translation.

episodes.title: Make an AI sound like a YouTuber (LAB)
episodes.description: Train a recurrent network on video transcripts to generate sentences resembling a creator's speech.

episodes.title: Reinforcement Learning
episodes.description: Explore learning through outcomes and rewards, including the difficulty of assigning credit for success.

episodes.title: Symbolic AI
episodes.description: Represent problems through symbols and logical search rather than neural-network learning.

episodes.title: Robotics
episodes.description: Explore how AI helps robots address localization, planning, and manipulation while performing specialized tasks.

episodes.title: AI Playing Games
episodes.description: Build a tic-tac-toe player using minimax and examine games as settings for testing intelligent systems.

episodes.title: Let’s make an AI that destroys video games (LAB)
episodes.description: Create a game-playing system using evolutionary neural networks and a carefully designed fitness measure.

episodes.title: Humans and AI working together
episodes.description: Explore how human creativity and computational strengths can complement each other in collaborative teams.

episodes.title: How YouTube knows what you should watch
episodes.description: Compare recommendation methods and investigate both their usefulness and their failures.

episodes.title: Let’s make a movie recommendation system (LAB)
episodes.description: Build a personalized movie recommender from existing ratings using the LensKit library.

episodes.title: Web Search
episodes.description: Explore web crawlers, indexes, interaction signals, and different ways search systems return information.

episodes.title: Algorithmic Bias and Fairness
episodes.description: Recognize common sources of unfairness in datasets, measurements, feedback, and deliberately corrupted information.

episodes.title: Cats vs Dogs? Let’s make an AI to settle this
episodes.description: Use an attempted pet recommendation to investigate how bias enters apparently objective systems.

episodes.title: The Future of Artificial Intelligence
episodes.description: Explore the course’s outlook on AI’s future and the gap between its systems and imagined general intelligence.
